entity.name: Mattia Egloff
entity.description: Creator and maintainer of Vauchi — privacy-focused updatable contact cards via in-person QR exchange. E2E encrypted using Signal protocol primitives (X3DH + Double Ratchet), decentralized, no accounts required. Core in Rust; CLI and desktop (Tauri) clients functional, iOS (SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin/Compose) clients in development.

projects.name: Vauchi
projects.description: Privacy-focused updatable contact cards. Exchange contact information in person via QR code, with end-to-end encryption. When you update your phone number or email, everyone who has your card sees the change — without any central server having access to your data. Uses Signal protocol cryptography (X3DH + Double Ratchet) with an oblivious privacy-preserving relay. Self-hostable; no accounts, no phone number, no social graph.
